explication: Arthas is a live Java diagnostics tool: an engineer attaches to a running JVM, issues commands through an interactive or remote interface, and receives diagnostic results without restarting the application. Its command surface spans class and classloader inspection, decompilation and redefinition, runtime tracing and monitoring, profiling, and heap-object inspection. The repository also includes an MCP server and experimental gRPC/web and tunnel interfaces. The graph uses README and indexed source references; unsampled implementation links are omitted where their wiring is not established.
